notes: Replace placeholders separately for every new PDF, website, publisher archive, or source collection.
The gate is publisher-agnostic. Never hard-code one publisher such as Isha into permanent policy.

Publisher, author, book title, institution, private person, private place, source-biography phrases, citations, source URLs, and named source works stay internal and must not appear in public blog copy.
Use allowed_public_terms for legitimate culinary geography, established dish names, or other terms that should remain public even if they also appear in source metadata.
Ordinary culinary phrases such as cooked with, learned from, volunteer, or programme are not blocked globally; block them only when they identify source provenance for the current source.
